subject: Subprocessor inventory & evidence handoff — ClearChain request
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@clearchain.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor inventory + evidence request (SOC2 / KMS residency)

Hi Tessa,

Following up from our procurement intake: ClearChain is running a scoped SIG/SOC2 review ahead of our pilot. Can you send an updated subprocessor inventory and any evidence you can share for the items below by EOD 25 May?

- CSV/list of active subprocessors (roles: hosting, KMS, telemetry, logging, backups)
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine) and date range covered
- KMS residency statement (where keys are stored, onshore/offshore, HSM vs soft-KEK)
- Any telemetry/ingestion evidence (what logs are retained and for how long)

If you have a single zip or Drive folder we can review, please share a secure link and a short manifest. Also let us know if some items are covered by your Dedicated/Private offering vs hosted API.

Thanks — Daniel
Daniel Park
Vendor Risk Manager, ClearChain
security@clearchain.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@clearchain.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor inventory + evidence request (SOC2 / KMS residency)

Daniel —

Thanks for the note. We're happy to support the review. I'm attaching a first-pass subprocessor inventory (CSV) and our most recent SOC 2 Type II report. A few quick clarifications:

- Hosted API customers use our Redwood-managed KMS (keys in our FIPS-validated HSMs in us-west-2).
- Dedicated & Private customers can configure customer-managed KMS (BYOK) and, for Private on-prem installs, keys stay entirely in-customer infrastructure.
- Telemetry/log retention: platform-level logs are retained 90 days by default; audit logs for Dedicated customers can be extended as part of the contract.

Attachments included:
- redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20260518.csv (subprocessor, role, region, contract owner)
- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025.pdf (redacted ops sections)
- evidence_manifest_2026-05-18.xlsx (manifest with links to artifacts)

Ben Carter (cc'd) will be our evidence curator and will drop a Drive link for the larger artifacts by EOD today. If you need onshore residency guarantees for keys we can scope a short addendum for Dedicated/Private customers — happy to discuss.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Trust & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@clearchain.com>

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor inventory + evidence request (SOC2 / KMS residency)

Thanks, Tessa — appreciate the quick turnaround. Couple of follow ups from our security review team:

1) For the hosted KMS: can you confirm the HSM vendor (e.g., AWS CloudHSM, Vault HSM) and whether keys are multi-region replicated? We need to know if private key material ever leaves us-west-2.
2) Can you provide a short mapping that ties each subprocessor to the specific data types they process (PII, telemetry, billing tokens)? That's what our data flow reviewers need.
3) For SOC2: can you confirm the report date range (period of review) and whether any exceptions were noted last cycle?

I've attached a short questionnaire (3 pages) that would help speed verification. If it's easier, we can hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through.

-Daniel
(attachment: clearchain_qna_short.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@clearchain.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor inventory + evidence request (SOC2 / KMS residency)

Daniel —

Ben here (Evidence & Integrations). Quick answers inline and I've attached a KMS residency matrix and an expanded CSV mapping (subprocessor -> data types).

1) HSM vendor & replication: Hosted KMS is backed by AWS CloudHSM in us-west-2. We do not replicate private key material outside the configured region unless a customer explicitly enables cross-region backup; by default keys remain in us-west-2 HSMs.

2) Subprocessor -> data mapping: see attached column "data_categories" in redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20260518.csv. High-level:
   - Logging/telemetry: Datadog (anonymized traces, no customer prompt text unless debug-mode enabled)
   - Object storage backups: S3 (encrypted at rest)
   - KMS: AWS CloudHSM (hosted), or BYOK by customer for Dedicated/Private
   - Embedding index provider (opt-in for some customers): uses anonymized vectors, hashed identifiers only

3) SOC 2 report: period covered 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30. No exceptions impacting the controls in scope were reported; we included the auditor's manager letter in the PDF footer.

Drive link (secure, restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodEvidence — artifacts: key rotation logs (redacted), KMS config snippets, CAIQ answers.

Attachments: kms_residency_matrix_20260518.pdf, expanded_subprocessor_data_mapping_20260518.csv

If helpful, propose a 30-min sync Tuesday 19 May 10:30am PT; otherwise we'll drop the remaining artifacts into the Drive and grant your team a read-only view.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Evidence & Integrations
Redwood Inference

Tessa
